summary.content:
Today's selection covers 99 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 65 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI and Anthropic bosses push UN for global terms on AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: AI-Powered Phishing Platform EvilTokens Disrupted by Microsoft
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 58 articles published in the last 24 hours
